title: Commodities Brief — 27 Nov 2026
intro: Commodities display a striking divergence this Friday afternoon, driven by massive safe-haven inflows into precious metals and sharp geopolitical tensions in the Middle East. Risk sentiment remains fragile as equity indices ease and yields retreat.

sections.heading: 🛢 Oil desk
sections.content: Crude benchmarks are moving in opposite directions, with WTI advancing 1.91 percent to 85.28 while Brent slips 2.72 percent to 92.04, compressing the spread to 6.76 dollars. Markets are digesting fatal drone attacks in Kuwait alongside aggressive presidential remarks regarding regional conflicts, overshadowing underlying supply adjustments. Traders continue to monitor inventory dynamics and OPEC+ production posture as physical curves recalibrate.

sections.heading: Natural gas & products
sections.content: Natural Gas surges 8.81 percent to 3.557 on renewed heating demand expectations, while RBOB gains 0.82 percent to 2.462 and Heating Oil softens 0.67 percent to 3.678. Refined product cracks remain volatile as consumers transition toward peak winter consumption patterns.

sections.heading: Metals
sections.content: Precious and industrial metals are rallying aggressively, led by Silver up 10.58 percent to 44.29, Gold rising 4.61 percent to 3,698.80, and Copper climbing 6.03 percent to 5.654. This broad advance is supported by tumbling US 10-year yields and robust industrial demand indicators despite a modest tick higher in the DXY to 103.79.

sections.heading: Agriculture
sections.content: Agricultural markets show mixed action with Wheat down 1.01 percent to 564.00, Corn higher by 1.27 percent to 439.50, Soybeans up 0.75 percent to 1,243.25, and Coffee edging up 0.13 percent to 276.00.

sections.heading: Potential scenarios
sections.content:
- *▲ Bullish · WTI — above 86.00 opens 89.00 · invalid below 84.00*
Geopolitical escalation in the Middle East drives further buying momentum.
- *▼ Bearish · Brent — below 91.00 opens 87.50 · invalid above 93.50*
- *▲ Bullish · Gold — above 3,750.00 opens 3,900.00 · invalid below 3,650.00*
Falling real yields and strong safe-haven demand fuel record inflows.

sections.heading: Key risks
sections.content:
- Unpredictable Middle East developments threatening critical energy infrastructure.
- Abrupt shifts in sovereign bond yields impacting broad asset allocation.
